worldcombat.skill.gravity.summary: Press a gravity well into the chosen ground: bodies inside are dragged down, floating identities are torn off, and moves that fly into the air can no longer be started. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.use.0: Pull a foe out of the air
worldcombat.skill.gravity.use.1: Shut down the foe's flight and levitation
worldcombat.skill.gravity.use.2: Open up air targets for Ground moves
worldcombat.skill.gravity.description.0: Press a gravity well of radius %1$s blocks into the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.description.1: Bodies off the ground are pulled down at %1$s blocks/tick and stay pinned %2$s after landing.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.description.3: Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.description.4: Moves carrying the native gravity flag cannot be started inside the well, and the floating identities fly/bounce/magnetrise/telekinesis are torn off. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.form.0: Crushing: a smaller, deeper well that pulls harder (x1.4) and lasts longer (x1.15), at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.form.1: Wide: a wider, shallower well (radius x1.3) with -2 ticks start-up and x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of x0.75 pull and x0.8 life.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to press the gravity down, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.gravity.preference.cru: On = crushing: radius x0.8, pull x1.4, life x1.15, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown. Off = wide: radius x1.3, -2 ticks start-up, x0.9 cooldown, at the cost of x0.75 pull and x0.8 life.
The companion presses a well only while a threat is within this distance; lower presses up close, higher sets it up in advance.
On: press a well only when a threat is off the ground, flying or floating, saving it for targets that really need pulling down. Off: also use it as a setup field against any threat.
Press the well on the foe
On: the well is pressed at the threat's position, dragging it and whatever stands beside it down. Off: it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to press the well.
